title: Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion
japaneseTitle: コードギアス 反逆のルルーシュ (Hangyaku no Lelouch)
author: Ichirō Ōkouchi, Gorō Taniguchi & Majiko!
description: In Area 11 (formerly Japan), exiled Britannian prince Lelouch Lamperouge gains the Geass, the 'Power of Kings' granting absolute obedience, from the enigmatic C.C. Donning a mask as the masked vigilante Zero, Lelouch leads the Black Knights in a rebellion against the Holy Britannian Empire.
